scorecard.rationale: A paper-filtered coffee crossover reported less acute mental fatigue than flavored water in healthy habitual caffeine consumers. The measured caffeine component links this exposure to a Parkinson placebo-controlled capsule trial, whose Fatigue Severity Scale point estimates favor easing with intervals spanning both directions. The small regular-versus-decaf espresso comparison has mixed individual responses and shares brewed coffee across arms. Turkish coffee gave an inconclusive fatigue comparison with later raw means favoring water. A counterbalanced abstinence study in habitual users documents withdrawal fatigue, which can affect interpretation of acute coffee comparisons. The decaf caffeine-addition trial did not measure fatigue. A public conversation reports perceived energy and fatigue responses with distinct exposures and uncertain attribution. The two separately interpretable comparisons still support a minimal easing lean against the frozen worsening hypothesis.
